verses.1: David gathered all the officers of Israel: the officers who served in the government, the officers who managed the king’s household, and the officers who were responsible for all the king’s possessions and treasures. They came to Jerusalem with their shields and armor, along with all the nobles and officials.
verses.2: And David, the king, stood up and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! With all my heart, I am determined to build a temple for the house of God. I will also prepare a place for our God’s feet to rest. I will do this with all my strength.”
verses.3: And God said to me, “Do not build a house in my name. For you are a man of wars and fighting; you shed blood.”
verses.4: And Jehovah, the God of Israel, chose me from all my ancestors to be king over Israel forever. For in Judah, he chose me as ruler; in the house of Judah, my ancestors also chose me to rule over all of Israel.
verses.5: And from all my children, Jehovah has given me many sons. He chose Solomon as his son to sit on the throne of Jehovah’s kingdom over Israel.
verses.6: And Solomon said to me, “You shall build my house and my court, for I have chosen him for my son. And I will be his father.”
verses.7: And I will prepare his kingdom for eternity, if he strengthens himself to obey my commandments and laws, just as he does today.
verses.8: And now, in the eyes of all Israel, let the people of Jehovah be obedient and keep all of Jehovah’s commandments. Thus, you will inherit the good land, and your descendants will inherit it for generations to come.
verses.9: And you, Solomon’s son, know the God of your father. Serve him with a whole heart and sincere devotion. For all those who seek Jehovah, and all those who think carefully about their actions, if they seek him, he will be found for them. But if they abandon him, he will leave them forever.
verses.10: Now see, now Jehovah has chosen you to build the Temple of God. Be strong and do it!
verses.11: And David gave Solomon his son the construction of the Temple, along with its utensils, its furnishings, and all its internal structures and chambers.
verses.12: And he will build all those things that were in heaven, for the courtyards of the House of God, and for all the halls around the sacred places of the House of God, and for the sacred places themselves.
verses.13: And to the priests and Levites, and to all those who perform the duties of the House of God, and to all those who are involved in the work of the House of God.
verses.14: To gold, by weight; to gold for all kinds of labor and work. For all things made of silver, by weight, for all kinds of labor and work.
verses.15: And for the weights of gold, its tins are made of gold. For the weights of silver, their tins are also made of silver. They serve as weights for gold and silver.
verses.16: And the gold is used to make tables for weighing purposes. It’s also used to make tables and other objects made of gold.
verses.17: And the ingots and coins, and the gold bars are of pure gold. And the weights for gold are measured by weight; and the weights for silver are also measured by weight.
verses.18: And on the altar of the goddess, gold was beaten into small pieces. And on the wheels of the chariot, gold was used as decorations and ornaments for the chariot of the covenant of Jehovah.
verses.19: Everything is written by Jehovah himself. He knows all the details of this creation.
verses.20: And David said to Solomon, “Be strong and have courage. Do not fear or tremble, for the LORD God is with you. He will not leave you alone until all your work in the house of the LORD is completed.”
verses.21: And behold, the priests and Levites were divided into groups, each group responsible for one specific task related to the service of the Temple. They worked together with you in all your endeavors, serving those who were generous in their wisdom. The singers and all the people also contributed to your efforts in every way possible.
